categories.main_business_segments: Tailim Package Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: manufacturing and sales of corrugated cardboard and corrugated boxes, production of corrugated paperboard raw materials, and freight transportation. The company and its subsidiaries focus on these segments with manufacturing facilities across multiple locations in South Korea.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automated production and logistics integration systems for manufacturing corrugated cardboard and boxes. Production involves processing corrugated paperboard raw materials into finished packaging products, with continuous investment in upgrading processing and converting equipment to enhance capacity and quality. The manufacturing process is highly customized, based on 100% made-to-order production to meet diverse customer specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tailim Package serves primarily industrial customers requiring packaging solutions, including sectors such as agriculture, electronics, food, pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce. The company’s products are used as intermediate goods for packaging various consumer and industrial products, with a strong domestic market focus and some export activities. Key customers include corrugated box manufacturers and end-users needing customized packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with production plants located in industrial hubs such as Siheung, Gumi, Pocheon, Yongin, Paju, Cheongwon, Ulsan, and Masan. While the business is predominantly domestic, there are some export sales primarily through local trading companies and direct export orders to foreign customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tailim Package operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing corrugated paperboard raw materials and converting them into finished corrugated boxes and packaging products. It also provides freight transportation services supporting its logistics needs. The company sources raw materials domestically and from affiliated companies upstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding production capacity through investment in advanced processing equipment and enhancing product quality to meet diverse customer demands. While there is no dedicated R&D activity reported, continuous improvement in production technology and quality control is emphasized to maintain competitiveness and customer satisfaction. Environmental compliance and sustainable production are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of corrugated cardboard, corrugated boxes, and related packaging products on a made-to-order basis. The company also earns revenue from freight transportation services. Sales are mostly domestic with some export sales, and payment terms vary from cash to up to three months credit depending on customer agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tailim Package is positioned as a leading mid-sized player in the South Korean corrugated packaging industry, holding approximately 16-17% domestic market share in corrugated boxes and around 4% in corrugated paperboard raw materials. The industry is competitive with several large regional players expanding their market presence. Tailim’s strengths lie in its nationwide production network and advanced automated facilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 719.6 billion KRW, with a decline of 8.2% compared to the previous year, and operating profit of 22.2 billion KRW, down 28.2%. Total assets stood at about 716 billion KRW, showing a 9.9% increase year-over-year. The company experienced a slight decrease in equity and net income, reflecting challenging market conditions and price pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tailim Package emphasizes high-quality, customized packaging solutions delivered with strict quality control and timely delivery to maximize customer satisfaction. Its competitive advantage is based on a fully integrated production and logistics network with advanced automation, enabling rapid response to diverse customer needs and maintaining stable supply. The company also highlights its environmentally friendly products made from 100% recyclable materials.
